turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Hi, I'm sorry for your loss. How are you doing today?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Thank you. Some days are better than others.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Of course. Can I start with your age?

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: What is your marital status now?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I'm widowed. My husband died in 2023.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: I'm sorry. What is your income at the moment?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: It's about fourteen thousand a year, mostly from his pension that came to me.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Do you pay rent or do you own your home?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I rent. It's a thousand, sorry, it's actually twelve hundred a month for a small place.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Do you have dental coverage through work or privately?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: No, there's no dental coverage. I haven't had any in a while.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: When did you last file your taxes?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: The last return I filed was for 2022. I haven't filed since my husband passed.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Thank you. Are you a Canadian citizen?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yes, I'm a citizen. I've lived here my whole life.
